submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires retrospectively when the current token completes a memorized configuration in the text just read: a word-internal fragment continuing a fixed stem (kehid+up in kehidupan, yor+uz in görüyoruz, user_+bg in identifiers, catch+phrase, pro+verb), the closing word of a fixed collocation (remember+that, is+disabled, Not+only, the+fact), or a lexically uncommon whole word typically met in a determiner frame (motto, zones, boolean, unboxing, vampire). It stays quiet on ordinary compositional pairings of common words (the house/table/water/history), on the same single-token nouns stripped of their framing determiner, and on novel or unknown strings (zxq, florp), with residual misses on both sides (memorized common frame-heads fact/number/people fire; rare knight/council/session stay quiet); its output suppresses ordinary-English continuations rather than promoting any specific next token.
